metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the hunting query 'HUN - Rare Process Per Device (org-wide rarity)'

properties.displayName: HUN - Rare Process Per Device (org-wide rarity)
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotempty(SHA1)
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId), DeviceNames = make_set(DeviceName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine), Folder = any(FolderPath)
          by SHA1, FileName
| where Devices <= 2
| where Folder !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
     and Folder !startswith @"C:\Windows\WinSxS"
| sort by LastSeen desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hypothesis - A binary that runs on exactly 1 device estate-wide is either a developer toolchain leak, niche LOB software, or attacker tooling. Surface process executions where the SHA1 has been seen on <= 2 devices in the last 14 days.
